name: Dayton
takeaway: Dayton's aggregation continues with AEP Energy through SOPEC at 10.691¢/kWh, 100% renewable, from June 2026 through the June 2027 meter read. The prior rate was 8.71¢.
hook: Dayton accounts on the city program are AEP Energy at 10.691¢ through the June 2027 meter read, up from 8.71¢. AES Ohio still delivers.
notes: SOPEC administers Dayton's aggregation and AEP Energy supplies it at 10.691¢/kWh, 100% renewable, through the June 2027 meter read. Prior term 8.71¢ through June 2026. AES Ohio delivers. City rate block: 12 months starting June 2026. City FAQ also writes June 2026–May 2027. Opt-down rate on the city page is 10.576¢. October 26, 2026 opt-out notice (PUCO Case 14-936-EL-GAG) prices enrollment at 10.691¢ from the next meter read through the June 2027 meter read; the supply agreement runs to the June 2029 meter read. AEP Energy's Dayton page still shows 8.710¢ through the June 2026 meter read. Sources: https://www.daytonohio.gov/155/Electric-Power-Aggregation https://www.sopec-oh.gov/rates/city-of-dayton/ http://www.energychoicematters.com/stories/20260409i.html https://d3lfrcwhbtghia.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/20261015134626/Dayton.pdf

name: Riverside
takeaway: Riverside aggregation at 9.33¢ expired June 30, 2026. Accounts are now on AES Ohio standard supply.
hook: Riverside's city program ran out in June — accounts there flipped to AES Ohio default. Worth a rate comparison.
notes: SOPEC rate 9.333¢/kWh through June 2026. AES Ohio territory. Adjacent to Dayton; same repricing exposure window.
